verdict: Leads are coming in, but rising cost per lead needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 127 leads from Meta at an average cost of $6.19 per lead — a solid baseline. However, in the most recent 7 days, ad spend scaled up sharply while lead volume grew only modestly, pushing cost per lead up by roughly 107% in that window. The primary driver is the dominant campaign, which absorbed 85% of total spend but has shown declining efficiency over the last several days. We are pulling back that campaign's budget and refreshing its creative this week to bring cost per lead back in line. You should see efficiency stabilize in the next reporting period; lead volume may dip briefly while the adjustment takes hold.
